mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_admin_resource( id, tenant_id, resource_type, resource_key, status, payload_json, active_flag, last_rotated_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceKey}, #{status}, #{payloadJson}, #{activeFlag}, #{lastRotatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, resource_type, resource_key, status, payload_json, active_flag, last_rotated_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_admin_resource WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND resource_type = #{resourceType} AND resource_key = #{resourceKey}

SELECT id, tenant_id, resource_type, resource_key, status, payload_json, active_flag, last_rotated_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_admin_resource WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND resource_type = #{resourceType} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, resource_key ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_ops_rollback( id, tenant_id, target_type, target_id, status, reason, requested_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{targetType}, #{targetRef}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{requestedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, target_type, target_id, status, reason, requested_by, created_at FROM tb_ops_rollback WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
